source_sheet.note: Uses the accepted original Koyora rear idle companion sheet as the art source so body shape, ring, side puppet decorations, palette, and silhouette remain locked to the existing runtime art.

prompt_summary: No new image-generation pass. Recombined pixels from the original Koyora companion idle sheet: frames 0-14 push both original sleeves forward/upward in a deliberately large motion; frames 15-24 pull them inward toward the body. The runtime puppet rope/string VFX is intentionally not drawn into this sheet.

postprocess.moved_region: both viewer-side sleeve polygons from the original idle cells
postprocess.visible_motion_tuning: Large two-sleeve overlays plus active-only 112px draw size keep the arm-thrust / pull-in readable in live gameplay.
postprocess.note: The original hanging ring strings and side puppet decorations are retained because they are part of Koyora companion identity; only the extra skill rope/string blast is omitted.
